title: Harness profile v1
description: How to invoke, isolate and read one coding-agent CLI (docs/repo-evaluation-contract.md §6). An input, not a produced artifact, so it carries `schema`. `invoke` and `version_cmd` are argv lists: each element is one argument after placeholder substitution, and the element "{tools}" is replaced by the argument list of the selected tool mode. Nothing is passed through a shell. The `guidance` block is the DECLARED loading behaviour and is only ever verified by the reach probe, never trusted.

delegation.description: How to run without subagents (`repo run --delegation none`): per tool mode, the argument list that replaces that mode's `tools` entry. A tool mode not listed here is refused (list every tool mode the profile may run with); a profile without `none` cannot run `--delegation none`. It restricts tools only: a skill with `context: fork` can still start a subagent.

egress.description: Hosts the agent container may reach through the framework egress proxy (contract §2). `*` stands for exactly one whole DNS label and the last two labels are literal, so `*`, `**` and `*.com` are refused. Same pattern as repos/manifest.py HOST_PATTERN.

bin_companions.description: File names the harness executable needs beside it (a helper it starts from its own directory). `repo run` mounts each, from beside --bin, read-only next to the executable in the agent's container.

native_prompt.description: The harness runs its own built-in prompt (a native review mode such as `codex exec review --commit HEAD`): `invoke` need not pass {prompt}, the task prompt is not given to the agent, and `repo reach` refuses the profile. Default false.

answer_format.description: Converts the final answer before grading: `codex-review` appends a ```json block of findings parsed from Codex's native review text (`- [P1] title — path:12-14` plus a body).

import_max_depth.description: How many hops of @imports the harness follows from a guidance file; absent: unlimited.

claude_rules.description: The harness reads .claude/rules/**/*.md (repo budget counts them); absent: false.

prompt_suffix.description: Appended to every task prompt after a blank line, for what the harness needs the agent to know about running headless (for example that background commands are refused).

args_if_present.description: Workspace file name -> arguments appended after the tool-mode arguments when that file exists in the run's workspace and the tool mode is `all` (--tools none and read do not limit MCP tools; for example --mcp-config .mcp.json, so a repo's MCP servers start only when it ships them).

config_files.description: Files written into the per-run config directory before the agent starts, name -> content. Placeholders: {config_dir} and {support_dir} (the framework's read-only helper scripts, such as the no-background hook), both as the agent's container sees them.
